title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode5 The Harmony We Discovered

meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wow...! That felt so good! My heart's pounding! It's like Amy and Dorothy really found a way to make up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I thought so too...!
It's all thanks to you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was having so much trouble understanding how to sing in character, but it became so much easier after talking about how Amy and Dorothy would feel...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
Our next practice is gonna go great!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! All that's left is to find a way to harmonize with Honami and Saki...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!!
Just watch, this is gonna be a super wonderhoy song in the end!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I hope so too. Let's keep trying our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already this late...?
We should get back to our room soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no, you're right!
Time for practice!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Okay, Shiho gave me some wonderful advice, so I need to make the most of it during practice today...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the group before us is still practicing. Maybe I can practice a little on my own with just my sticks.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, Hona!
Are you here to practice too?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Does that mean you too, Saki? Are you here to get the keyboard?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I mean, yesterday didn't go as well as we hoped it would, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu even gave us some really good advice, we couldn't figure it out... It kept bothering me so much afterward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I felt the same way after that too. I actually just asked Shiho about it just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you did?
What did she say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She really said that? Our Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She actually pointed out how her usual recommendations don't apply because we're in a new situation with different people...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I understand. I might've been stuck in Leo/need mode this whole time too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To be fair, she's the one who taught us everything we know about being in a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're with Emu and Kohane now. We should try to play more freely as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Would you mind if we practiced together, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been meaning to try what Emu said yesterday about understanding how our characters would feel as we play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Wanna get started then?
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for joining me, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You bet! I should be thanking you too, Honami! I have a way better idea of what to do during the chorus now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too.
It became so much easier to play after realizing how Amy and Dorothy would feel during this scene.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? Emu was right. It really is important to let your emotions flow through a song like this, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Given this, practice today should go great! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I do, but we still have to find a way to harmonize with Emu and Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I think the group in front of us is about to finish.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make the most of today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Honami, Saki!
You're here early!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Were you practicing together just now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! We were trying some stuff while talking about how to make our performance sound more like a musical!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We thought about what you said yesterday, Emu, and tried understanding how Amy and Dorothy would feel during this scene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's great!
Kohane and I just practiced that too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Emu and I met during our free time, and she suggested that we try figuring out how our characters would feel as they sang.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We thought about what Amy and Dorothy would do, and practiced it lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we did. And thanks to Emu, I think I know how Amy would feel when she sings this song now...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Then practice today should go very smoothly!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...!
Should we start by warming up like we did yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll go grab some chairs and desks again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna help too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see, which desks and chairs would work best...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Emu! Emu!
I'm back!!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Miku!
Oh, you gotta hear this! Practice today's gonna go extra good!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That's great!!
I can't wait to hear you girls play!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll do everything I can to make sure you feel as wonderhoy as possible!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll count us in.
Here we go. One, two, three, four.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Okay, this is it. Sing as Amy. You want to make up with Dorothy...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Whoa, it's like she's really Amy and wants to make up with Dorothy!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to do the same! I have to sing like I want to make up with Amy!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, wow! Emu and Kohane sound amazing! They must've practiced so hard!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's like Amy and Dorothy are right in front of us, and are finally ready to make up...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That means I need to...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Musicals need to be more fun or more emotional, you know? We should focus more on bringing those emotions to the surface just before the climax.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I also think that you should play the way you like, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll find a way to make everything work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (From here, we're supposed to show how happy Amy and Dorothy are about making up...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to do my best too♪ Emu and Kohane are awesome, but I have to play like I mean it too!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to make it so everyone can understand how they feel too...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We're finally in sync...
This is absolutely incredible...!!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We did it. This is it...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone, that was amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was super duper awesome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was! I could tell how Dorothy and Amy felt so much that I actually started to tear up while playing♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank goodness too...
We should be more than ready by the time we present now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget!
Can we try changing the lead-up to the chorus just a little bit? I think I can make it even more wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that part. I'd be for that too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wanna try it one more time and record it on our phones?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, let's.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I think Tenma and her group are still practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, looks like it. We should probably hold off on getting our props off the stage until they're finished.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I'd hate to interrupt them at a time like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're doing a musical piece, right? It's so cool how they're not afraid of playing instruments in front of a crowd...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to work extra hard to keep up with them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But doing a play only in English... I'm so worried about memorizing my lines and saying them right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You'll be fine, Minori.
Just imagine yourself reciting them flawlessly!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. We'll be there to help if anything happens too... Well, as long as I don't forget either...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two...!
I'm so glad that they put us all in the same group!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wasn't that worried to begin with, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, here! I think we can make this chorus sound extra happy and give everyone extra-big smiles!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this the part you were talking about where you want us to sing so everyone knows how Amy and Dorothy feel?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means we need to adjust how we play during that part a little too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We can try that next time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Looks like you're doing just fine, Honami...)
